# NewsBox

A small box of community news: events, congratulations, notices and open calls. It can float in a corner of the screen.

```tsx
import { NewsBox } from '@kafka-ds/react'
```

## When to use it

- To tell the community what is happening without taking over the page: up to three items at a time.
- Four kinds: `evento`, `felicitacion`, `aviso`, `convocatoria`. Each has an icon and a name in words.
- `floating` for the corner of the screen; leave it off to place the box inside the page.

## When not to

- Anything urgent or that needs an answer: use Alert or ConfirmDialog.
- More than one box per page.
- Long titles: one line of news, the details go in the list or on the page it links to.

## Examples

### Several news

Shows up to three items, one at a time. The dots change the item; nothing rotates by itself. Closing an item removes it and the next one takes its place. Give it four items and only three are shown.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-md"><Demo /></div>
```

### One news

With a single item the dots are not shown.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-md"><Demo items={ITEMS.slice(3)} label="Un aviso" /></div>
```

### Floating

`floating` pins the box to the bottom right of the screen (full width minus a margin on phones). The frame below stands in for the screen. Put it once per page, at the end of the page.

```tsx
<div className="relative h-96 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-(--kafka-color-bg-sunken) [transform:translateZ(0)]">
  <Demo items={ITEMS.slice(0, 2)} floating label="Novedades en pantalla" />
</div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` (required) | `NewsItem[]` |  |  |
| `onDismiss` (required) | `(id: string) => void` |  | Called when the reader closes an item. The page owns the list and removes it. |
| `viewAllHref` | `string` |  | Where "Ver todas" goes. Without it the link is not shown. |
| `floating` | `boolean` | `false` | Pins the box to the bottom right of the screen. |
| `label` | `string` |  | The region's name. Defaults to "Novedades"; change it only if the page has more than one box. |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- **A labelled region** ("Novedades"), not a dialog: it does not trap focus or block the page. Use `label` if a page ever has more than one box.
- **It never rotates by itself.** The dots change the item, and the change is announced politely. They are real buttons ("Ver noticia 2 de 3") with `aria-current` on the active one.
- **The kind is said in words**, not only by the icon.
- The close button is 44 px and its name includes the title. Closing removes the item and the next one takes its place; when the last one is closed the box disappears, so move focus somewhere sensible in `onDismiss`.
- The entrance animation is removed under reduced motion.

## Content

- Title: what happened, in one line. Details: the date first, then the place or the group.
